Bihar BCECEB BSFC Various Post Online Form 2026 – Last Date – Full Details

Bihar Combined Entrance Competitive Examination Board (BCECEB) has released the notification for the Assistant Manager/ Assistant Account officer/ Accountant/ Quality Controller and Lower Division Clerk (LDC) Post in Bihar State Food & Civil Supplies Corporation Limited (BSFC). This recruitment has been issued for 259 posts. Online applying process for Bihar BCECEB BSFC Various Post Recruitment 2026 has started on 25 August 2026 & the candidates can apply till 24 September 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for Bihar BCECEB BSFC Various Post Recruitment 2026 which has given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 25 August 2026
  • Last Date : 24 September 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 25 September 2026
  • Correction Date : 26-28 September 2026
  • Exam Date : Notify Later
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, EBC, BC : Rs. 1200/-
  • SC, ST, PwBD : Rs. 600/-

How to Apply Online

  1. Click on the direct Apply Online link in the Important Links section below.
  2. Complete new registration with your Name, Email, and Mobile Number.
  3. Fill the application form with personal, educational, and address details.
  4. Upload scanned photograph, signature, and required certificates.
  5. Pay the applicable examination fee online and download the submission receipt.
